profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ PlayOn Sports
profile.summary: Google Cloud certified data engineer with experience designing, implementing, and enhancing business intelligence solutions across multiple relational database and big data technologies. Skilled in analyzing, designing and implementing various end-to-end business intelligence solutions. Demonstrated ability to consistently produce defect-free, on-time code in an Agile development process, while building excellent working relationships with stakeholders and other development teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Services
positions.description:
Experience:
- Part of a team that built a platform enabling rapid deployment of new predictive models written by datascientists
- Implemented a Java gRPC service (and corresponding Python client library) to abstract data retrieval forpredictive model input features
- Designed and implemented a modern data platform to replace multiple legacy predictive models and services
- Implemented a process for data engineers to run entire GCP pipelines locally, without incurring the cost ofcloud resources for development
- Standardized the process for moving data between our on-prem infrastructure and the cloud using a
combination of KSQL, Kafka Connect, Pub/Sub and Dataflow

positions.title: Manager
positions.description:
Formal Training: 
• DataStax Cassandra
• MicroStrategy 10
• Data Engineering on Google Cloud Platform
• Tableau Desktop 10

Current Project:
• Build and design an enterprise data warehouse and ETL processes using SQL Server Integration Services in the Microsoft Azure cloud environment
• Design dimensional data model used for reporting
• Setup and configuration of SQL Server instances
• Implement development standards for on-going maintenance including source control using Team Foundation Server and Git repositories in Visual Studio Online
• Create SQL scripts to automate various warehouse load, monitoring and maintenance activities
• Create reusable Java libraries to load data to the warehouse from REST API sources
• Performance tuning queries used in the loading of and reporting from the data warehouse
• Consulting on data governance and reporting best practices, as well as report building in Microsoft Power BI

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Formal Training: 
• Agile Methodologies
• Hadoop / MapReduce (Cloudera)

Experience:
• Ensured standards and best practices are followed for all ETL and data modeling changes in the enterprise data warehouse, operational data store, and Oracle Business Intelligence reporting tool.
• Performed code reviews of ETL, data modeling, and database changes across multiple teams.
• Established high-level design for new data integration projects and changes to existing ETL processes.
• Mentored newly hired developers on various teams throughout the company.
• Interviewed candidates for engineering and management positions across the company.
• Successfully completed the DevArc leadership program for emerging software architects.
• Created a shell script to automate ETL releases in Informatica.
• Designed an ETL process to eliminate complex, manual reporting of corporate travel data from varying data source types.
• Designed and implemented a new process to generate master hardware and software asset data from six source systems.
• Developed complex ETL mappings in Informatica using multiple source and target types, including flat files, relational databases, and web services.
• Modeled data structures in Oracle Business Intelligence repositories for enterprise reporting.
• Maintained SSIS packages for pulling data from SharePoint lists.
• Performed multiple ETL re-architecture projects to increase accuracy and performance of data loads.

positions.title: IT Analyst - Trading Support
positions.description:
Formal Training: 
• Python

Experience:
• Supported whole loan inventory and position management applications.
• Performed troubleshooting and corrected problems within middle-tier Java code and Unix scripts.
• Created Unix scripts to ensure accurate and timely data feeds to downstream applications.
• Developed complex SQL scripts and stored procedures on SQL Server and Sybase databases.
• Created SSIS packages to automate the standardization of files uploaded by the accounting team.
• Enhanced regulatory reports to comply with government regulations, including reports supporting HMDA and BASEL II regulations.
• Coordinated yearly disaster recovery testing efforts for supported applications.
• Managed relationships with business partners and end users through the effective use of periodic meetings to discuss opportunities for improvement within the application, as well as user feedback and status of future application enhancements.

positions.title: IT Process/Data Analyst
positions.description:
• Increased the accuracy, efficiency, and flexibility of all existing Help Desk reports.
• Designed interactive reporting solutions used by senior management across the IT organization for the purposes of metrics analysis.
• Developed new tools and processes for the Help Desk analysts to troubleshoot client issues more effectively.
• Maintained reports and performed analysis on key performance indicators at the Enterprise Help Desk.
• Performed on-going training for the IT knowledge tool used by Help Desk analysts and application support teams.
• Created and maintained documentation within the IT knowledge tool, collaborating with support teams throughout the IT organization when necessary.

positions.title: IT Operations Release Analyst
positions.description:
Formal Training: 
• Unix Shell Scripting

Experience:
• Redesigned the existing change management system, including database schema and user interface.
• Reviewed change requests to assess risk and ensure compliance.
• Developed a new method of tracking and reporting on past due and unauthorized changes in the IT environment.
• Part of the team that designed the new Change Management process flow in Remedy.
• Supported over 125 new users during the initial roll out of the Remedy Change Management application.
• Enhanced and supported the Remedy Change Management application.
• Conducted end-user training for internal and external users of our service management tools, which included managers, directors, and vice presidents.
• Managed relationship with international Remedy support team.
• Mentored and created a Professional Development Plan for a summer intern.
